body:
TREE SYCOPHANT CR 6

XP 2,400
N Huge plant
Init -4, Senses tremorsense 300 ft., Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 4, flat-footed 13 (-4 Dex, -2 size, +9 natural)
hp 75 (10d8 +30)
Fort +10, Ref +0, Will +3
Damage Immunities piercing
Damage Vulnerabilities fire

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., climb 5 ft.
Melee slam +11/+6 (2d8+4 bludgeoning plus splinters)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 3, Con 16, Int 1, Wis -, Cha –
Base Atk +7; CMB +13, CMD 19, immune to trip

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Single-Minded (Ex)

These trees will attack any threat to the parasite leaf, regardless of damage taken or danger.

Splinters (Ex)

Creatures struck by a tree sycophant do not recover hit points on resting. This persists until a Medicine check DC 15 is made on affected creatures, or the creature is raised to maxi mum hit points through magical healing.

Moving Trees (Ex)

Tree Sycophants cannot make attacks of opportunity.

ABOUT

The parasite leaf can be harvested with 1 minute of work. It grants 3 doses of parasite leaf.

The parasite leaf will regrow in 1 week, but its tree sycophants will not. If the parasite leaf is harvested 5 times, it will not return.
